scope: Exploratory retrospective robustness extension; all historical periods previously accessible and inspected
primary_selection: Validation WAPE only, eight candidates per family, fixed original train/validation/test partitions
budgets: Equal number of candidates, not equal wall-clock compute; common maximum training limits within family type
paired_control: Same two heads, nonnegative ReLU context, positive initial slope weights; only monotone variant projects slope weights and biases to nonnegative after each optimizer step
rolling_selection: Three predeclared smaller candidates per core family, train before preceding three-month validation interval; test next three months; train preprocessing separately
refit_sensitivity: Twenty product-cluster training bootstrap replicates. Refit and select among two fixed candidates per tree/Poisson family; fixed validation/test, plus calendar-block resampling. Limited candidate pool, conditional retrospective uncertainty
joint_support: Sample 10000 test rows with fixed seed. Nearest training record with matching category and life week and discount within 2.5 points; all numerical model features plus one-hot categorical fields; distance threshold from observed validation nearest-neighbor distances
classification: Choose occurrence threshold on validation macro F1 using fixed grid 0.05 to 2 units, compare historical test using frozen threshold; remains derived diagnostic
business: No causal business outcome can be supplied without intervention and cost data; no fictitious profit simulation
